Confirm or reject each name as a retrieval path. State the free quota, the price of the cheapest paid tier, the identity and the per-object cap. Skip a name that `scripts/fr search NAME` already finds as a record.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- debrid/vipfile $.identity_cost.kind: The homepage states free file hosting with basic features and no registration; the premium checkout lists card, PayPal, crypto and gift-card methods, so no page read shows a card as the gate. The premium page quote 'Traffic Per Day 100 GB' says nothing about identity.
- debrid/rapidfileshare $.verdict: The premium page lists paid plans only, but it does not say that free downloads do not exist; the site carries Upload and Sign Up links, and fresh reads of the homepage (sha256:8c456da0b0bd10d8666bb880959134c7d9b92206fb9ad4ceafa056be81a49043) and the register page state no free allowance either way.
- debrid/hotlink-cc $.verdict: A fresh read of https://hotlink.cc/premium shows a Free column: limited speed, a queue, and 1 file / day of traffic. A free tier exists, so paid-only is contradicted; fails-quota fits the page.
- debrid/jumploads $.identity_cost.kind: The homepage offers 'Signup Free'; a fresh read of the join page shows no form fields beyond a terms checkbox, so no page read says the sign-up asks for an email.
- debrid/sharemods $.identity_cost.kind: The pages say downloads need no account (the Free column of the premium page has Download volume Unlimited, and the homepage says no wait timers for players) and only uploading needs a sign-up; no page read shows what the sign-up asks for, so email is not stated. - debrid/jumploads $.verdict: The homepage offers a free sign-up and lists paid plans; neither it nor a fresh read of the premium page (sha256:2eca4d027ca95d2bfc7e5715dc4005f5f5840f4b1ceebc4d6a61e1e7a53f8d61) says whether a free account can download. paid-only is an inference, not a reading.
- debrid/hotlink-cc $.identity_cost.kind: The payment methods are icons with no names in the text, so no page read names a card; the premium page also shows a Free tier of 1 file / day with no stated sign-up.
